incident.question: what does bauer kompressoren do
observed_failure: The broad company question was reduced to low-information terms including 'does' and 'kompressoren'.
A supplier-contract page and a fuel-gas brochure displaced the available company-overview evidence.
The general renderer exposed an internal requested-topic evidence dump instead of a concise answer.

change_scope: V4 company-overview intent and requested fields
public development regression cases V4-R01 and V4-R02

verification.railway_error_filter_note: Four normal Uvicorn startup lines were classified by Railway as stderr/error-filter entries; none contains an application error.
verification.expected_answer: BAUER Kompressoren manufactures medium- and high-pressure air and gas compression systems, including systems for generating breathing air. Beyond its compressor systems, BAUER supplies air and gas purification, controls, storage, gas-measurement equipment, and related accessories. Documented applications include breathing-air supply for divers and firefighters, plus fuel-gas systems for bio-CNG, biogas, hydrogen, and LNG.
